verdicts.why: In Purpose in the Machine (#46) Randolph takes the team to the English castle; the old machine opens the portal and breaks, Daisy keeps it open, and Fitz jumps in and brings Simmons back.
In Maveth (#54) Mack, Morse and Hunter secure the castle's portal room; Fitz and Coulson return from the planet and Hive secretly comes back in Ward's body. One entry covers both #54 leads.
Radcliffe sends Fitz out in #86 and he is in isolation at S.H.I.E.L.D. in #87; in #88 Fitz has no Framework scenes.
In World's End (#88) Hope's code is deleted when Aida (Ophelia) shuts the Framework down, Radcliffe is deleted, and Mack then leaves with Elena.
Same #88 event as lead 1: Mack refuses to leave until Hope's code is deleted in the shutdown; one entry covers both.
In No Regrets (#84) Mace holds back debris from crushing a student at a HYDRA Enlightenment Camp while the children escape, is crushed, and his real body is found dead.
In Identity and Change (#83) Aida goes by Ophelia or Madame Hydra, and Fitz kills Kitsworth and imprisons Radcliffe; the Darkhold reading is earlier and outside the Framework.
Coulson leaves the Framework in #86; in #88 he becomes the Ghost Rider and burns Ophelia in the real world, and the agents are taken there too.
In Self Control (#81) Daisy and Simmons hack into the Framework and find the others in an altered world where HYDRA has replaced S.H.I.E.L.D.
In Farewell, Cruel World! (#86) Daisy, Coulson and May cross out through Radcliffe's exit, Radcliffe sends Fitz then Simmons through, and Mack stays.
Same #81 event as lead 6; one entry covers both.
Fitz kills Kitsworth and imprisons and tortures Radcliffe and Daisy in #83, so the lead's event is the #83 entry; #84 gets its own entry from the Mace lead.
Same #86 event as lead 7: Radcliffe sends Fitz through the exit, followed by Simmons.
In Orientation Part One (#89) the team arrives on the Lighthouse, May and Simmons see the shattered Earth, and Coulson learns they are in a Kree-ruled future; #90 is Part Two.
The Fitz and Simmons wedding in The Real Deal (#100) is in the present-day Lighthouse bunker under Lake Ontario, after the team returns.
In The End (#110) Daisy chooses Mack to lead S.H.I.E.L.D. as Talbot attacks present-day Chicago; Mack's 2091 fight is in #98.
In Past Life (#98) on the 2091 Lighthouse, Kasius drinks odium, Simmons disables him and Mack kills him; Flint builds the monolith and stays with Tess and the refugees, who watch the team leave.
The wedding in #100 takes place in the present-day Lighthouse after the return, not in 2091.
Same #98 event as lead 2; one entry covers both.
In Principia (#101) the team hunts gravitonium in Baton Rouge and on the Principia in the present, and Deke realizes Fitz and Simmons are his grandparents; his 2091 escape is #98.
In Best Laid Plans (#97) May flies the Zephyr up into space through the gravity storm while Daisy fights Sinara again and kills her.
In The Last Day (#96) on the 2091 surface, Voss impales Robin, who dies comforted by May after telling her how to save the world with Flint.
The Force of Gravity (#109) is set after the return, with May dueling Qovas on his ship; May admits her feelings in #105, also in the present.
The End (#110) is in present-day Chicago; future Enoch's apparent death powering the time machine on the Zephyr is in #98.
Same #98 event as lead 2: Flint builds the monolith and stays with Tess and the refugees.
In Fun & Games (#94) Grill finds the team and holds them captive until Flint, newly through terrigenesis, kills him with geokinesis.
Same #98 event as lead 2: the team frees the captive Inhumans and survivors before leaving.
In Orientation Part One (#89) the Kree imprison the team and take Mack and Yo-Yo for interrogation, and Daisy arrives in time to free them; it is a separate event from the arrival entry.
Noni is captured in the Lion's raid on Minoan Crete; the duel and the self-destruct are at his deep-sea complex, which the fandom places in the Indian Ocean, not on Crete.

The Partition scenes are in a village and train yard in British India, not Karachi, so the entry is wrong; but no source puts the Veil's opening at the train station (the bangle is struck in a store after the chase), so that detail goes.
value: Back in the present, the Veil opens, and Najma dies closing it before Kamala's mother and grandmother find her.

verdicts.why: The events are right and in Karachi, but this lead and the Waleed lead describe one Clandestine attack in Seeing Red, so they get one merged entry.
value: Kamala visits her grandmother and trains with the Red Daggers. When the Clandestines attack, Najma kills Waleed in a chase through the city, and her blade strikes the bangle.

verdicts.why: Waleed is killed by Najma in the same Clandestine attack and chase in which her blade strikes the bangle, so this lead shares the one merged #4 entry.
